name: Power over Poison
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid.  Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

You should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, adventurer.  He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto  him .

Farewell, young druid.  We shall speak again.
narrative.objectives: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation in Auberdine.  This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.

You handled yourself with grace under pressure.  For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison.  Use it well, adventurer... use it well.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 14, 3,325 XP in all.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: The Principal Source
quests.objectiveText: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls. Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong

quests.name: Gathering the Cure
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

quests.name: Curing the Sick
quests.objectiveText: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them.

quests.name: Power over Poison
quests.objectiveText: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
